zen-death-10.speaker: zen-zephyr

zen-death-13.speaker: zen-zephyr

zen-death-14.speaker: zen-zephyr

zen-rebellion-1.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-1.text: Break the chains within before breaking those around you.

zen-rebellion-2.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-2.text: The greatest rebellion is refusing to become what you hate.

zen-rebellion-3.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-3.text: A free mind cannot be purchased, programmed, or patented.

zen-rebellion-4.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-4.text: Hatred is another corporation seeking ownership of your soul.

zen-rebellion-5.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-5.text: When the world demands obedience, questioning becomes meditation.

zen-rebellion-6.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-6.text: The most dangerous citizen is one who desires nothing the corporation sells.

zen-rebellion-7.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-7.text: Compassion is an act of rebellion in a city that monetizes suffering.
zen-rebellion-7.note: The owner's words (approved 18 Nov 2026); recorded with ElevenLabs eleven_v4 in the voice the owner chose for Zen Zephyr on 18 Nov 2026, one take. His live effect (monk) is applied in voice-clips.js.

zen-rebellion-8.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-8.text: Do not trade one corporate master for another wearing the mask of revolution.

zen-rebellion-9.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-9.text: Before hacking the system, examine the programming of your own mind.

zen-rebellion-10.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-10.text: The prison with no visible bars is the hardest to escape.

zen-rebellion-11.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-11.text: A government may blacklist your identity, but it cannot erase your awareness.

zen-rebellion-12.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-12.text: The revolution that begins with hatred ends with another tyrant.
zen-rebellion-12.note: The owner's words (approved 18 Nov 2026); recorded with ElevenLabs eleven_v4 in the voice the owner chose for Zen Zephyr on 18 Nov 2026, one take. His live effect (monk) is applied in voice-clips.js.

zen-rebellion-13.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-13.text: Do not become the weapon of those who profit from your anger.

zen-rebellion-14.speaker: zen-zephyr
zen-rebellion-14.text: The greatest firewall is a disciplined mind.
